test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 13 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A person says that the 26th day of a month is a Friday. Which of the following was the 5th day of the same month?
solution:
A person says that the 26th day of a month is a Friday. 

26 → Friday

Friday falls on these dates:

 
• 26 - 7 = 19 
 
• 19 - 7 = 12 
 
• 12 - 7 = 5

So, the 5th day of the month is Friday.

Hence, ‘**Friday**’ is the correct answer.
